title: Law to speed up inspection of dangerous public trees
summary: This bill would require the Department of Parks and Recreation to inspect a public tree within 72 hours after receiving a complaint that it poses an imminent risk of harm, and to report back to the requester within another 72 hours on planned action or why it disagrees. Parks would also need to publish an annual report, due by November 1, with detailed data on such risk-related tree inspection requests. The law would take effect 120 days after becoming law.
